title: Parity step in multiplication
statement: Let $x$ be a bit string, $v$ a register assignment bounded by $4(|x|+1)$ in every register, and $b\in\{0,1\}$. If $b\equiv v(11)\pmod 2$, the fixed multiplication program reaches the carry-halving state from the parity state with bit $b$, without changing the registers or recording an answer. Otherwise it halts with answer false.
